newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian retail sales rise 2.3 pct in Q4 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italian retail sales rise 2.3 pct in Q4 1996.

text.p: Italian retail sales rose 2.3 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 from the same quarter in the previous year, national statistics institute Istat said in a statement.
The retail index, composed of indices for small, medium-sized and large retail outlets, rose to 142.2 from 139 in the final quarter of 1995.
The year-on-year rise in the third quarter of 1996 was one percent while the increase for the whole of 1996 over the previous year was 1.7 percent.

The retail index in the fourth quarter of last year was boosted above all by a surge in sales at large outlets, which rose 3.9 percent, while sales by small outlets grew 2.1 percent and sales by medium-sized outlets shrank by 0.8 percent.
